svg.title: One vault, a whole crew
svg.desc: A diagram of everything that works on the Bonsai vault, in three columns. All day: capture copies chats in, an index builder and two local search models keep search current, and a read-only gateway lets Claude Code, Codex and Copilot search the vault. Every night: Claude proposes memory changes, a reworder fixes the wording, plain code writes a morning checklist, you tick boxes, and the next night only the ticked changes are applied after a snapshot. For a profile: a smaller Claude scores chats, Claude extracts claims with quotes, plain code checks every quote word for word, a separate Claude fact-checks, Claude writes questions, and you answer them. None of the AI can change a note on its own.
svg.text: Bonsai runs a crew of small helpers, each with one job. Some are AI models, some are plain code that checks the
models' work, and you sign off on anything that changes.

A plain folder of markdown notes, synced by Google Drive. Chats come in through capture, your agents
write only to their own inbox folders, and every other change goes through Apply.
Eight AI jobs in all, and none of them can change a note on its own.
